icebreakers.title: Icebreakers
cards: What's the best gift you've ever received?
What's a holiday tradition from your family that others find strange?
If you could spend the holidays anywhere in the world, where would it be?
What's the worst gift you've ever had to pretend to love?
What's your favourite holiday food, and who makes it best?
What song instantly puts you in a festive mood?
What's one thing you want to do before the year ends?
What was the highlight of your year?
Which movie do you rewatch every winter?
What did you believe as a kid about the holidays that turned out to be false?
What's the most useful thing you learned this year?
If your year was a movie, what would it be called?
Who here would you trust to choose a gift for your mum?
What's a small thing that made you really happy recently?
What's your New Year's resolution, and how long will it last?

wyr.title: Would you rather
cards: Would you rather get one big gift or ten small ones?
Would you rather spend the holidays at the beach or in the snow?
Would you rather give up chocolate or cheese for a year?
Would you rather wrap 100 presents or cook dinner for 20 people?
Would you rather know every gift in advance or never get to choose your own?
Would you rather sing karaoke in front of everyone here or dance alone for one minute?
Would you rather have a holiday that lasts a month or a bonus that's a month's pay?
Would you rather wear an ugly sweater all day or a Santa hat all week?
Would you rather only eat leftovers for a week or skip dessert for a month?
Would you rather be the Secret Santa for your boss or your ex?
Would you rather lose your phone for a day or your wallet for an hour?
Would you rather read minds or be invisible at this party?
Would you rather receive a handwritten letter or an expensive gadget?
Would you rather travel back to last New Year's Eve or skip ahead to next one?
Would you rather host the party every year or never be invited?

truth.title: Truth or dare
cards: Truth: Have you ever regifted a present? Who got it?
Dare: Do your best impression of someone in this room until someone guesses who.
Truth: What's the most embarrassing thing you've done at a party?
Dare: Sing the first line of a holiday song in a dramatic opera voice.
Truth: Who here do you think got you as their Secret Santa?
Dare: Give a 30-second toast to the person on your left.
Truth: What's the last thing you searched on your phone?
Dare: Wear something silly that the group picks for the next three rounds.
Truth: Have you ever peeked at a gift before you were supposed to?
Dare: Tell a joke. If nobody laughs, tell another one.
Truth: What's a secret talent nobody here knows about?
Dare: Let the person on your right post a (kind) story from your phone.
Truth: What's the most you've ever spent on a gift for someone?
Dare: Talk like a news reporter until your next turn.
Truth: What's one thing you'd change about this year if you could?

family.title: Family friendly
cards: Name three things that are red and green.
If you were a holiday decoration, which one would you be and why?
What would you do if you were Santa for one day?
Which animal would make the best reindeer?
Describe your perfect snow day.
If you could invent a new holiday, what would people celebrate?
Act out your favourite holiday activity. Everyone else guesses.
What would you put in a gift for someone who has everything?
What's the funniest thing that happened in our family this year?
Hum a holiday song. Who can name it first?
If your pet could talk, what would it ask for as a gift?
What's one kind thing someone here did for you this year?
Make up a new name for one of Santa's reindeer.
If you could have any superpower just for the holidays, what would it be?
Everyone says one word to build a holiday story, going around the room.
